name: FUZZ_SEQ_PROD_SETUP

#define FUZZ_SEQ_PROD_SETUP()                                                  \
  do {                                                                         \
    FUZZ_ASSERT(FUZZ_seqProdSetup() == 0);                                     \
    FUZZ_seqProdState = FUZZ_createSeqProdState();                             \
    FUZZ_ASSERT(FUZZ_seqProdState != NULL);                                    \
  } while (0)
